note: Wired in by building-kit.js: game.js house() builds walk-in buildings from village-modular.glb pieces; castle-models.js builds castle_wall/castle_tower/castle_gate masonry and farm-models.js the farm_hut from town-buildings.glb. castle-walls.glb is not loaded by the game. Each GLB holds many pieces as named root nodes; load the file once and clone the node named `node`. Materials and textures are shared inside each file (dedup). Units are metres, +y up, glTF +z forward.

game_reference.house_shell: game.js house(): 4 × 3.84 m footprint, walls 3 m, ridge 4.4 m, door on +z, whole group scaled by `scale` (1.05–4.4) and width/depth

style_note: Quaternius pieces are textured (painterly PBR); KayKit pieces are flat-shaded stylised. Mixing both in one town reads inconsistently up close: prefer Quaternius modular shells for walk-in town buildings and use KayKit buildings for far LOD, hamlets, castle walls and one-off landmarks.
